Three.js 0.180.0, vendored from the official npm `three` distribution.
Includes the unmodified minified WebGL modules. OrbitControls has one local
patch to `onMouseWheel`: permit wheel zoom during `ROTATE`, retaining the active
gesture and its existing start/end lifecycle. Track this patch when updating
Three.js. MIT license
in THREE-LICENSE.txt. No runtime CDN or npm installation is required.
